name: Oulbaene Bard (CR 6)
body:
OULBAENE BARD
CR 6

XP 2,400
Oulbaene bard 5
LN Small monstrous humanoid
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 17, flat-footed 13 (+2 armor, +5 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
hp 67 (8 HD; 3d10+5d8+29)
Fort +5, Ref +12, Will +7; +4 vs. bardic performance, language-dependent, and sonic
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee mwk sickle +13/+8 (1d4), mwk sickle +13/+8 (1d4), 2 tentacles +10 touch (1d6 acid plus revolting touch)
Special Attacks bardic performance 16 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate, inspire competence +2, inspire courage +2), revolting touch (DC 14)
Bard Spells Known (CL 5th; concentration +9)

2nd—alter self, distressing tone (DC 16), invisibility
1st—cure light wounds, expeditious retreat, grease (DC 15), invisibility alarm
0 (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, mage hand, open/close, prestidigitation, read magic

TACTICS

During Combat Oulek calls for aid from the compound’s guards before casting distressing tone to sicken as many opponents as possible. Thereafter, he relies on his Multiattack feat and revolting touch to nauseate anyone sickened by his spell, or wields his wand of oneiric horror to impede anyone trying to close on him.

Morale Completely loyal to Mr. Sarlu, Oulek does everything possible to ensure his master’s survival. If necessary, he casts invisibility and/or expeditious retreat to appear to flee so he can come to Mr. Sarlu’s aid in the middle of battle.

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 20, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 18
Base Atk +6; CMB +10; CMD 21 (25 vs. disarm)
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Dodge, Multiattack, Nimble Moves B, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +15, Bluff +12, Climb +14, Diplomacy +12, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (arcana) +6, Knowledge (geography) +6, Knowledge (history) +6, Knowledge (local) +8, Knowledge (nobility) +6, Perception +8, Perform (oratory) +12, Sense Motive +6, Spellcraft +5, Stealth +15, Swim +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Perception
Languages Aquan, Common, Oulbaene; telepathy 30 ft.
SQ amphibious, bardic knowledge +2, lore master 1/day, multilimbed, versatile performance (oratory)
Gear potion of cure moderate wounds, wand of oneiric horror (32), leather armor, mwk sickles (2), 848 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Multi-Limbed (Ex)

An oulbaene has six lower and four upper tentacular appendages. It cannot use its lower limbs to attack, but they provide it with Nimble Moves as a bonus feat. Two of its upper limbs serve as its primary arms, and the other two upper limbs are tentacles that can deliver a specialized secondary touch attack (see revolting touch).

These tentacles cannot be used to wield weapons, but can manipulate or hold items (including a buckler, but no larger shields); unlike its arms, the tentacles do not allow it to use extra arm slots. Suckers on its limbs enable an oulbaene to climb sheer surfaces and provide a +4 bonus to its CMD vs. disarm attempts.

Revolting Touch (Ex)

A creature touched by an oulbaene’s slimy tentacle must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be sickened for 2d4 rounds. A sickened creature that fails its saving throw is nauseated for 1 round; this second failed save does not extend the duration of the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds on its initial saving throw is immune to that oulbaene’s revolting touch for 24 hours. The save DC is Constitution-based.
